restaurant.name: Mr Bean Cafe & Restaurant
restaurant.tagline: Cozy Creative Bistro, Gourmet Waffles & Sizzlers
restaurant.subTagline: Jammu's premier intimate bistro sanctuary in Shastri Nagar — golden crisp Belgian waffles, sizzling cast-iron platters, velvet pasta bowls, and leisurely bistro conversations.
restaurant.concept: Warm contemporary bistro lounge catering to couples, youth, celebration parties, and food lovers seeking artisanal continental comfort food and dessert artistry.

location.address: Main Road Shastri Nagar, Near Dussehra Ground, Adjacent to Gandhi Nagar
location.landmarks: Opposite Dussehra Ground Road, 3 minutes from Gandhi Nagar Gole Market & Nai Basti link

amenities: Intimate Velvet Booths for Dates & Celebrations
Acoustic Ambient French & Indie Jazz Background
Strict Segregation for Pure Vegetarian Dishes

marketAnalysis.locationContext: Shastri Nagar is an affluent residential hub tightly interwoven with Gandhi Nagar and Nai Basti. It is celebrated in Jammu for its community dining culture, family evenings, and youth foodies seeking relaxed cafes away from excessive traffic while remaining centrally located.

targetDemographics.need: Low-lit ambient booths, warm waffles to share, sizzling platters, and attentive unobtrusive service.
targetDemographics.vibeRequirement: Soft acoustic indie jazz, warm caramel lighting, intimate seating.

targetDemographics.need: Shareable sizzler combos, loaded fries, stuffed garlic breads, photogenic mocktails and celebratory waffles.
targetDemographics.vibeRequirement: Lively yet refined ambience, quick service, celebration cake sparklers.

targetDemographics.need: Freshly baked pizzas, creamy pastas for kids, sizzling vegetarian platters for elders, pristine hygiene.
targetDemographics.vibeRequirement: Spacious seating, hospitable staff, consistent continental flavours.

culinaryPillars.description: Crisp golden malted waffle irons baked fresh per order, topped with authentic Belgian chocolate ganache, fresh strawberries, and gelato.
Red-hot cast-iron skillets sizzling with herb butter rice, sautéed baby veggies, crispy crinkle fries, and house pepper jus.
Slow-simmered sauces from sun-ripened plum tomatoes and aged parmesan, tossed with al dente durum penne and stuffed garlic rolls.
Hand-shaken botanical coolers with Jammu kesar rose, fresh mint, and cold-churned thick milkshakes.

visualIdentity.designTheme: Warm Caramel Velvet Noir & Hairline Brass
visualIdentity.aestheticPhilosophy: Cozy European bistro minimalism meets contemporary cafe comfort. Matte smoked espresso backgrounds, razor-thin hairline borders, amber-gold accents reflecting candlelight and sizzling skillet embers.

hero.headline: Cozy Bistro Evenings & Gourmet Waffles in Shastri Nagar
hero.subheadline: Freshly iron-pressed Belgian waffles, smoking cast-iron sizzlers, and velvet pasta bowls. Jammu's cozy corner for heartfelt dates, laughter, and comfort cravings.

highlights.title: Golden Belgian Waffles
highlights.description: Iron-pressed malt batter served piping hot with pure Nutella, Belgian dark ganache, and Madagascar vanilla.

highlights.title: Smoking Cast-Iron Sizzlers
highlights.description: Red-hot table-side sizzler platters with herb-buttered rice, crispy fries, and rich homemade demiglace.

highlights.title: Velvet Pastas & Melts
highlights.description: Slow-simmered arrabbiata, truffled alfredo, and mozzarella-stuffed roasted garlic loaves.

items.name: Classic Nutella Drizzle Belgian Waffle
items.description: Golden malted waffle with deep crispy pockets, smothered in warm imported Nutella, toasted hazelnut crunch, and chocolate pearls.
items.ingredients: Crisp Belgian Malt Batter, Warm Nutella, Roasted Crushed Hazelnuts, Belgian Chocolate Pearls
items.pairing: Pairs blissfully with Hazelnut Espresso Frappe

items.name: Triple Belgian Chocolate Overload Waffle
items.description: Dark chocolate waffle base layered with melted milk chocolate, dark Belgian ganache, and white chocolate shavings with vanilla gelato.
items.ingredients: Callebaut Cocoa Waffle, Milk & Dark Ganache, White Chocolate Shavings, Gourmet Vanilla Gelato
items.pairing: Best enjoyed after a savory sizzler

items.name: Wild Berry & Whipped Cream Waffle
items.description: Crisp golden waffle crowned with wild blueberry and raspberry compote, cloud-like Chantilly cream, and powdered sugar dust.
items.ingredients: Belgian Batter, Wild Forest Berries, Natural Berry Compote, Fresh Whipped Chantilly Cream
items.pairing: Pairs with Jammu Kesar Rose Mojito

items.name: Lotus Biscoff & Salted Caramel Waffle
items.description: Warm speculoos waffle drizzled generously with smooth Lotus Biscoff spread, crushed spiced cookies, and Himalayan sea salt caramel.
items.ingredients: Malted Waffle, Lotus Biscoff Cream, Crushed Lotus Cookies, Artisanal Salted Caramel Sauce
items.pairing: Pairs with Iced Vanilla Latte

items.name: Mr Bean Signature Paneer Shashlik Sizzler
items.description: Skewered tandoori marinated cottage cheese, charred bell peppers, and sweet onions served over a sizzling bed of garlic butter herb rice, crinkle fries, and smoky black pepper demiglace.
items.ingredients: Marinated Cottage Cheese, Tri-Color Bell Peppers, Butter Herb Rice, Crinkle Fries, Smoky Brown Sauce
items.pairing: The crowd-pleasing dinner centerpiece of Shastri Nagar

items.name: Hickory BBQ Smoked Chicken Sizzler
items.description: Succulent boneless chicken breast char-grilled in hickory smoke glaze, presented sizzling over buttery parsley rice, sautéed baby corn, steamed greens, and spiced fries.
items.ingredients: Prime Chicken Fillets, Hickory Smoke BBQ Glaze, Parsley Butter Rice, Seasoned Crinkle Cut Fries, Charred Greens
items.pairing: Pairs smoothly with Green Apple Mint Fizz

items.name: Crispy Veg Patty Sizzler with Mushroom Jus
items.description: Two crispy herb potato-corn patties sizzled with buttery noodles, tossed oriental veggies, and roasted wild mushroom cream jus.
items.ingredients: Crisp Potato & Herb Cutlets, Sautéed Hakka Noodles, Sliced Button Mushrooms, Garlic Jus
items.pairing: Great with Blue Ocean Mojito

items.name: Spicy Peri-Peri Chicken Steak Sizzler
items.description: Fire-grilled peri-peri spiced chicken steak over cilantro rice, blistered tomatoes, jalapeño rings, and melted cheddar drizzle on a red-hot iron griddle.
items.ingredients: Peri Marinated Chicken Breast, Cilantro Butter Rice, Cheddar Sauce Melt, Blistered Tomatoes
items.pairing: Follow up with a cool Triple Chocolate Waffle

categories.name: Handcrafted Pastas
categories.tagline: Velvet Sauces & Al Dente Italian Penne

items.name: Mr Bean Signature Pink Sauce Penne
items.description: Our legendary harmonious fusion of fire-roasted San Marzano arrabbiata and thick parmesan alfredo cream, tossed with broccoli and black olives.
items.ingredients: Durum Wheat Penne, Italian Tomatoes, Heavy Cream, Aged Parmesan, Broccoli Florets, Sliced Olives
items.pairing: Served with warm roasted garlic baguette

items.name: Classic Alfredo Pollo Penne
items.description: Silky garlic butter white sauce simmered with cracked black peppercorns, tender grilled chicken breast, and freshly grated Grana Padano.
items.ingredients: Penne Rigate, Herb-Infused Butter Cream, Grilled Chicken Chunks, Cracked Black Pepper, Parmesan
items.pairing: Complements a chilled Peach Ice Cooler

items.name: Fiery Arrabbiata Rustic Penne
items.description: Slow-simmered rich red Italian tomato reduction loaded with crushed garlic, birds eye chili flakes, fresh Genovese basil, and extra virgin olive oil.
items.ingredients: Crushed Roma Tomatoes, Confit Garlic, Fresh Basil Leaves, Chili Oil, Durum Penne
items.pairing: Dips perfectly with Stuffed Garlic Bread

items.name: Baked Cheesy Macaroni Gratin
items.description: Elbow macaroni enveloped in triple cheese mornay sauce, baked golden in the oven with a herb panko crust until bubbling hot.
items.ingredients: Elbow Macaroni, English Cheddar, Mozzarella, Creamy Mornay Sauce, Herb Panko Breadcrumbs
items.pairing: Ideal comfort dish on a rainy Jammu evening

items.name: The Shastri Nagar Royale Burger
items.description: Handcrafted crispy corn & cottage cheese patty, cheddar slice, caramelized onions, crisp iceberg, gherkins, and house thousand island on toasted sesame brioche.
items.ingredients: Handmade Cottage Cheese & Corn Patty, Melted Cheddar, Caramelized Onion, Iceberg Lettuce, Thousand Island Sauce
items.pairing: Served with a side of peri-peri salted fries

items.name: Crispy Panko Fried Chicken Burger
items.description: Buttermilk-brined chicken breast coated in crunchy Japanese panko, topped with purple cabbage slaw, spicy chipotle mayo, and dill pickles.
items.ingredients: Buttermilk Fried Chicken, Panko Crumbs, Chipotle Aioli, Red Cabbage Slaw, Dill Pickle Slices
items.pairing: Goes great with an Oreo Thick Shake

items.name: Tuscan Grilled Vegetable Panini
items.description: Grilled zucchini, roasted bell peppers, mozzarella melt, and homemade sun-dried tomato tapenade pressed crisp in herb focaccia.
items.ingredients: Focaccia Bread, Char-Grilled Veggies, Sundried Tomato Spread, Melted Mozzarella
items.pairing: Pairs with Kesar Rose Mojito

items.name: Smoked Chicken & Jalapeño Club Panini
items.description: Shredded smoked chicken tossed with sweet corn, pickled jalapeño coins, garlic emulsion, and double cheddar cheese between toasted artisan sourdough.
items.ingredients: Shredded Smoked Chicken, Pickled Jalapeños, Sweet Corn, Garlic Herb Spread, Sourdough Loaf
items.pairing: Pairs with Green Apple Fizz

items.name: Mr Bean Special Exotic Veggie Pizza
items.description: Crisp thin crust topped with Italian marinara, whole milk mozzarella, crunchy broccoli, bell peppers, baby corn, black olives, and jalapeños.
items.ingredients: Plum Tomato Base, Mozzarella Cheese, Broccoli, Bell Peppers, Golden Corn, Jalapeños, Fresh Basil
items.pairing: Best shared with friends alongside loaded nachos

items.name: Barbecue Grilled Chicken & Onion Pizza
items.description: Tender grilled chicken tossed in sweet hickory BBQ glaze, caramelized red onions, fresh coriander, and bubbling mozzarella on crisp stone crust.
items.ingredients: Smoky BBQ Sauce, Grilled Chicken Breast, Caramelized Red Onions, Mozzarella, Cilantro
items.pairing: Pairs with Classic Chilled Cold Coffee

items.name: Margherita Classica with Buffalo Bocconcini
items.description: Simple perfection of slow-cooked Italian plum tomatoes, torn fresh bocconcini mozzarella, sweet basil, and cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil.
items.ingredients: San Marzano Marinara, Fresh Bocconcini Mozzarella, Fresh Basil Leaves, Extra Virgin Olive Oil
items.pairing: Pairs with Wild Berry Waffle dessert

items.name: Fiery Tandoori Paneer Makhani Pizza
items.description: Tandoor-charred paneer cubes in a spiced makhani sauce reduction, topped with diced capsicum, red onions, and melted mozzarella.
items.ingredients: Makhani Gravy Base, Tandoori Spiced Paneer, Crisp Capsicum, Onion Rings, Mozzarella
items.pairing: Pairs with Blue Lagoon Cooler

items.name: Molten Cheese & Jalapeño Stuffed Garlic Roll
items.description: Freshly baked artisan bread boat stuffed with roasted garlic herb butter, spicy pickled jalapeños, and an unforgettable mozzarella cheese stretch.
items.ingredients: In-House Bread Dough, Confit Roasted Garlic, Fresh Herbs Butter, Pickled Jalapeño Rings, Mozzarella Melt
items.pairing: The ultimate starter to open your bistro meal

items.name: Fiery Peri-Peri Loaded Cheese Fries
items.description: Crispy golden french fries tossed generously in African bird's eye peri-peri spice dust, topped with warm liquid cheddar and chopped chives.
items.ingredients: Golden Potato Fries, Peri-Peri Seasoning, Molten Cheddar Sauce, Scallions
items.pairing: Perfect for casual snacking and friendly debates

items.name: Crispy Corn Tortilla Nachos Grande
items.description: Piled high stone-ground corn chips layered with warm queso sauce, house fresh tomato salsa, black beans, jalapeños, and sour cream swirl.
items.ingredients: Corn Tortilla Chips, Warm Queso, Pico De Gallo Salsa Roja, Black Beans, Sour Cream
items.pairing: Pairs with Jammu Kesar Rose Mojito

items.name: Golden Herb Panko Paneer Fingers
items.description: Fresh cottage cheese batons breaded in herbed Japanese panko breadcrumbs, deep fried until shattering crisp, served with zesty tartar dip.
items.ingredients: Fresh Malai Paneer, Japanese Panko, Oregano & Thyme, Spiced Tartar Aioli
items.pairing: Dips into in-house sweet chili tartar

items.name: Jammu Kesar Rose & Mint Mojito
items.description: Local Kashmiri saffron extract and natural damask rose syrup shaken with fresh garden mint, lime juice, sparkling soda, and crushed ice.
items.ingredients: Kishtwar Kesar Infusion, Damask Rose Extract, Fresh Mint Leaves, Lime Slices, Sparkling Water
items.pairing: Refreshing counterbalance to any hot sizzler platter

items.name: Decadent Oreo Crumble Thick Shake
items.description: Double crushed Oreo cookies spun into thick vanilla bean ice cream and whole dairy, topped with cocoa whipped cream and chocolate drizzle.
items.ingredients: Oreo Cookies, Vanilla Bean Gelato, Whole Milk, Chocolate Fudge Drizzle, Whipped Topping
items.pairing: A nostalgic companion to our Royale Burger

items.name: Crisp Green Apple Fizz Cooler
items.description: Tart Granny Smith green apple nectar charged with lemon soda, sweet basil seeds, fresh mint, and cracked black salt.
items.ingredients: Green Apple Nectar, Clarified Lemon Soda, Sweet Basil Seeds (Sabja), Rock Salt
items.pairing: Cuts right through cheesy pasta sauces

items.name: Blue Lagoon Sparkling Mocktail
items.description: Electric blue curacao citrus cordial balanced with fresh lime wedge, mint sprig, Sprite, and crushed crystal ice.
items.ingredients: Blue Curacao Syrup (Non-Alcoholic), Lemon Juice, Sprite, Mint, Maraschino Cherry
items.pairing: A must-order for celebration photo moments

reviews.author: Pooja Gupta
reviews.text: Mr Bean Cafe is the warmest bistro in Jammu! We celebrated my sister's birthday here, and their Paneer Shashlik Sizzler with the sizzling demiglace sauce blew everyone away. And the Nutella Waffle is pure heavenly perfection.

reviews.author: Dr. Sameer Bandral
reviews.text: Intimate, quiet, and consistently delicious. Their Pink Sauce Penne has the exact Italian balance you rarely find in Jammu. The hairline ambient lighting and jazz make it the best date night spot in Shastri Nagar.

reviews.author: Vikram Singh Jamwal
reviews.text: Best sizzlers and waffles hands down. The cast-iron platter actually stays sizzling for 10 minutes at the table. Very polite staff and no chaos like commercial malls.
